summary: Converged the twice-transcribed directory-prefix overlap predicate into one shared library (scripts/lib/file-scope-overlap.sh), extended it with the session registry as a third bounded contention input consumed by both task-lock.sh acquire and orchestrate-batch-admit.sh (verdict schema bumped to orchestrate-batch-admit-v4 with a new session_active defer flavor and corroborated_by evidence field), wired batch admission into /research, /plan, /implement's plain multi-task paths, fixed /orchestrate's real dispatch path (standard and hard mode) to pass --session-id, and converged the four related documentation files onto the single implementation and three-input model. All 9 plan phases complete. Isolated-temp-root test suite (23 cases) and all four pre-existing gate suites pass.
decisions_made: Lazy-loaded the shared overlap-predicate lib inside task-lock.sh (only within cmd_acquire, on first use) rather than unconditionally at file-top, to keep reap/session-* subcommands working even when the lib is unavailable, and to keep the pre-existing isolated-temp-root test fixtures (which never copy the new lib dependency) passing unchanged.

Root-caused the known extension-loader gap for new scripts/ files to a missing manifest.json provides.scripts entry, and fixed it there rather than continuing to rely on a one-off manual copy workaround.

Tested the D4 'corrupt session DOES contend' property at the jq-harness level (calling session_contention() directly) rather than through the full integration path, since a real corrupt session-registry entry structurally can never carry file_scope data and so can never produce an observable overlap hit end-to-end.

Extended scope beyond the plan's literally-declared file list in three places after empirical verification surfaced real defects: orchestrate-dry-run-report.sh's defer_reason fallthrough mis-bucketing bug (Phase 6), skill-orchestrate/SKILL.md's real dispatch path never having passed --session-id at all (Phase 7), and skill-orchestrate-hard/SKILL.md's co-maintained transcription lagging that fix (Phase 9).
